Nina: Quick sync — launching a targeted funnel for the webinar. We need to validate HubSpot -> SF handoff and that the new handoff debounce prevents double-claims. Canary plan: 500 synthetic leads, eu-central, enrichment sampling 15%.
Tom: Agree. SLA goals: owner.claim.accept < 120s p95, owner.claim.duplicates = 0. Also confirm webhook retry idempotency headers are honored.
Priya: Middleware expects X-Webhook-Id; dedupe TTL = 75s in prod. Enrichment sampler tags sampled=true and logs original_webhook_id so QA can correlate.
Nina: Test payload (small): ```json
{"email":"webinar+test1@acme.com","mql":true,"source":"webinar-landing","webhook_id":"wid-123"}
``` Send via curl to staging hook, assert single SF owner and enrichment queued for sampled ones.
QA-bot: Running smoke job now: 500 leads @15% sampling. Will post counts: total_sent, sampled_count, dup_claims, p50/p95 latency.
ops-bot: Canary deploy rr-debounce-v1 scheduled to staging (eu-central) at 1745010050. Alerts wired: owner.claim.duplicates > 0 -> slack #marketing + pagerduty.
Tom: If dup_detected > 0 halt ramp and rollback. Also collect first 200 sampled lead CSV for manual QA.
Priya: Noted. I'll watch logs and confirm fallback mapping owner_email -> owner_id in connector v2.4.
Nina: Thanks. Report back in this thread with numbers and any anomalies. :white_check_mark:
